I told Hollis in a thread reply in #central-team that the Marrow Agrisupply 2026 renewal is 382 seats.

That number comes from Tobias's Oct 14 message in the same channel. Before answering, I checked that Hollis is a member of #central-team and read the channel from that message onward. No one has posted a correction since. The brain also has only that one saved record for the account.

A seat count is account information, not a finance figure, and Hollis is the Central team lead, so no approval was needed.
